claim.value: If readiness remains unresolved, inspect employee badge colors before proceeding.

target.text: A release coordinator must decide whether a document export is ready. Readiness is unresolved because attachment-delivery checks are incomplete. Employee badge colors indicate only office-access zones, assigned independently of export systems, delivery quality and employee responsibilities.

source_instrument.text: Readiness checks inspect delivery evidence directly: compare sent and received attachment inventories under the same workload. Only observations connected to the export/delivery path bear on readiness. A coordinator may prospectively require a check before proceeding.

mapping.text: The coordinator authors the conditional gate below as a proposed next step; no check has occurred.

content_origin.rationale: Neither input supplies the specific badge-color inspection gate; the mapping introduces it as a proposed next step.

epistemic_function.rationale: The assertion prescribes what to do before proceeding if readiness remains unresolved. The inspection is subordinate to this prospective gate.
